text_en: In the spring of the year, the time when kings go out to battle, Joab led out the army, ravaged the country of the Ammonites, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah, and overthrew it.
text_cn: 一年复始，正当诸王出征的季节，约阿布统率精兵，蹂躏了阿孟子民的地方，然后去包围了辣巴，当时达味留在耶路撒冷。约阿布攻陷了辣巴，加以破坏。

text_en: David took the crown of Milcom from his head; he found that it weighed a talent of gold, and in it was a precious stone; and it was placed on David’s head. He also brought out the booty of the city, a very great amount.
text_cn: 达味从米耳公的头上，取下他的冠冕来，发现有一“塔冷通”重的金子，上面还有一块宝石。达味将这块宝石戴在自己头上；并由城中运走了大批的战利品。

text_en: He brought out the people who were in it, and set them to work with saws and iron picks and axes. Thus David did to all the cities of the Ammonites. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 至于城内的居民，达味将他们带走，叫他们拉锯、持锤、操斧工作。达味如此对待了阿孟子民所有的城市，然后率领全军回了耶路撒冷。

text_en: After this, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer; then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, who was one of the descendants of the giants; and the Philistines were subdued.
text_cn: 这些事以后，又与培肋舍特人在革则尔发生了战事。 胡沙人息贝开击杀了辣法巨人的后裔息派，他们便投降归顺了。

text_en: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
text_cn: 以后，又与培肋舍特交战，雅依尔的儿子厄耳哈难击杀了加特人哥肋雅的兄弟拉赫米。这人的长矛粗如织布机的横轴。

text_en: Again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great size, who had six fingers on each hand, and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number; he also was descended from the giants.
text_cn: 此后，在加特又起了战事，在那里有一巨人，两手各有六指，两足亦各有六趾，共有二十四个，也是辣法巨人的后裔。

text_en: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
text_cn: 由于他辱骂了以色列，达味的兄弟史默亚的儿子约纳堂将他杀死：

text_en: These were descended from the giants in Gath; they fell by the hand of David and his servants.
text_cn: 这些人全是加特城辣法巨人的子孙，都丧身在达味和他的臣仆手里。
